professional_summary: Aspiring Data Analyst with a strong foundation in Python, SQL, Excel, Tableau, and Power BI. Enjoys working with data to uncover patterns, solve problems, and find meaningful insights. Has developed projects focused on ride-sharing optimization and customer churn analysis, applying data cleaning, visualization, and statistical techniques to real-world problems. Eager to use analytical skills to help businesses make better, data-driven decisions while continuing to grow in the field of data analytics.

points: Analyze large datasets from relational databases comprising over 2 lakh rows daily to identify trends and support business decisions.
Develop automated ETL pipelines using Python and SQL, reducing manual processing time by 40% while handling 1.5 million records per day.
Visualize key performance indicators through 12 interactive Tableau dashboards accessed by 30+ cross functional users daily.
Collaborate with product managers and engineers to define data requirements, aligning project scope for a team of eight stakeholders.
Monitor data quality metrics, detecting and resolving anomalies to improve reliability of analytical outputs.
Validated expertise in designing scalable data models, cleaning and transforming complex datasets, and enabling advanced analytics capabilities in Power BI.
Proficient in creating interactive reports, paginated reports, and deploying production dashboards with row-level security (RLS).
Expertise in writing DAX queries, establishing KPI metrics, and driving data-driven business decisions for cross-functional teams.
Comprehensive professional training in Python, SQL, Tableau, spreadsheets, and R for complete end-to-end data lifecycles.
Skilled in data extraction, data cleaning, data profiling, exploratory data analysis (EDA), and insight presentation to executive stakeholders.
Completed rigorous real-world capstone projects focusing on ride-sharing optimization and customer churn prevention.

projects.name: Ride IT Analysis
highlights: Developed end-to-end data pipeline in Python and SQL to profile, clean, and transform ride‑booking, cancellation, driver, and rating datasets, reducing data preparation time by 30%.
Engineered KPI suite and trend analyses using Tableau and Power BI, enabling stakeholders to identify a 12% increase in driver retention after targeted interventions.
Delivered interactive dashboards for senior leadership, consolidating key metrics and marketing subscription impact, supporting data‑driven decision‑making across product and operations teams.

projects.name: Credit Card Customer Churn
highlights: Built predictive churn model in Python leveraging SQL-extracted demographic and usage variables, achieving 85% accuracy in identifying at‑risk cardholders.
Segmented high‑risk customers by utilization patterns, income, and age, producing actionable cohorts that reduced projected churn by 8% through targeted retention campaigns.
Designed and deployed interactive Power BI and Tableau dashboards visualizing churn drivers and behavior trends, accelerating executive reporting cycle from weekly to daily.

projects.name: Airbnb Data Analysis
highlights: Developed Python and SQL pipelines to analyze Airbnb listings, identifying photo and amenity factors that lifted prices by 15%.
Performed seasonal and location trend analysis with Tableau, pinpointing peak pricing periods and high-value neighborhoods, boosting occupancy by 10%.
Built interactive Power BI dashboards with Matplotlib visualizations to present price trends and review sentiment, enabling data-driven pricing decisions.
